en: The image depicts a black-and-white street scene with early 20th-century architecture. There are several people walking, including a woman in period dress and a man with a cane, as well as a streetcar or tram in the center of the street. The buildings are multi-story and typical of late 19th or early 20th-century European urban design. The street is labeled 'Bahnhofstrasse', which means 'Station Street' in German. The image is captioned at the top with 'Freiberg i. S.' and at the bottom with '9118 Brück & Sohn, Meissen'.
